[[File:Mikael.png|thumb|250px|Mikael]] '''Mikael''' (Japanese: '''ミカエル''' ''Mikael'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==History== Mikael first appeared in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', where he participated in the [[Vertress Conference]] and was {{an|Bianca}}'s first opponent. He was shown to be aggressive in {{pkmn|battle}}. Mikael's strategy was to attack first, with his Watchog seen rushing towards [[Bianca's Emboar]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', his Watchog was [[Fainting|defeated]] and he was eliminated from the tournament. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mikael |pkmn=Watchog |img=Mikael Watchog.png |type1=Normal |epnum=BW103 |epname=Curtain Up, Unova League! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Watchog}} is the only Pokémon Mikael is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Vertress Conference against [[Bianca's Emboar]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', it was defeated. Watchog's known moves are {{m|Hidden Power}}, {{m|Tackle}}, and {{m|Crunch}}.}} ==Achievements== ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Mikael has obtained in the [[Unova]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'') ===Pokémon League=== Mikael has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Vertress Conference]] - Top 128 (''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |ja=五十嵐裕美 ''Hiromi Igarashi'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |fi=Antti Lang |fr_eu=Alessandro Bevilacqua |es_eu=Javier Lorca}} ==Related articles== {{Leaguetrainers|normal}}
